name: Home, Portfolio tab
alt: The old Mara app home on Android, Portfolio tab: total balance ₦2,896, an orange balance chart with 8h to 1y range, and the asset list (MARA Token, Nigerian Naira, USD Coin) under the floating bottom bar
note: A pasted device screenshot of the old app, so it is exported whole and not coded. Drawn in Figma at 306x680 with 12px rounded corners; export.png is the image fill itself at its original 1080x2400 (the fill is uncropped, same proportions as the box), square-cornered, decoded from the JPEG Figma holds and saved lossless, with its colour profile kept. image.webp is the same pixels as lossless WebP.
